gen-dafont-ozone-gf-halant: Compass-drawn and technical, Ozone holds every stroke to a single thickness, even where its round forms flare wide. Halant, a text serif, shows only a faint thick-thin shift, so paragraphs look sturdy and traditional.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: Geometric and drafted, Ozone looks ruled out in one pen width. Ozone excels at crisp, uniform lettering, while Hedvig Letters Serif offers sturdy, tall-bodied text with a tempered contrast that neither jolts nor flattens.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-montagu-slab: Technical and stripped back, Ozone bends every stroke like a paperclip. It does best as a drafted, uniform headline voice, whereas Montagu Slab handles reading, with a sizable x-height and gentle swings from robust downstrokes to slender turns.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-hentaigan: Ozone draws every stroke at a single thickness, its capitals barely taller than the lowercase and its round forms flaring wide. Noto Serif Hentaigana sits beneath with mild contrast and open curves, so the geometric heading and the traditional text feel like two registers of one page.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-ovo: Authoritative in a quiet way, Ovo keeps its thins only slightly lighter than its thicks, under a heading that runs like a neon tube. Ozone brings the uniform, technical line.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-bitter: Heavy and blunt, Plakkaat looks like bent straw. Bitter, the slab-serif body, is the grounded part, with a very large lowercase eye and an s you can see through.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-epunda-slab: Closed, heavy letters in Plakkaat look nearly sealed shut at their terminals. And Epunda Slab, a classic serif, keeps its c visibly gaping, so long paragraphs feel dignified and rounded.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-fauna-one: Stencil-cut and heavy, Plakkaat sets one steady width against the page. But Fauna One, a text serif, is the one built for reading, with shallow ascenders and a generous entry into each e.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-glegoo: Plakkaat is chunky and closed, its terminals curling nearly back to the stem. And Glegoo, a classic serif, opens wide with big counters and unclosed mouths, giving the heavy heading room to stand out.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-hanuman: Pipe-cleaner strokes curl shut in Plakkaat, with capitals barely above the lowercase. Plakkaat is the loud, closed voice, while Hanuman, a text serif, is the open, high-waisted one that carries the reading.
